name: Dysmorphophobia
source:
Two close friends, Xiao Long and Alicia enter an ominous cave located somewhere in the wilderness of Vancouver Island, that leads them into a long abandoned laboratory that contains a malformed hybrid creature of unknown origins...

[From [url=https://xerrex.itch.io/dysmorphophobia]Itch.io[/url]]
